# orly

> A turn-end gate for agent loops. At the end of every turn, the work is checked against
> the project's specs in one judge request, with facts decided in code; the agent keeps
> working until they hold. `orly judge` exits 0 = may stop, 2 = not done, 1 = could not run.

- [Install](docs/install.txt): setup, the API key, the .orly layout, environment variables.
- [Writing specs](docs/specs.txt): the spec tree, rules for judgeable specs, file, check and context evidence, mistakes as replayable cases, tuning.
- [The guard](docs/guard.txt): what counts as weakening the gate and where it is refused.
- [Porting](docs/porting.txt): module map, library calls, the CLI contract, the Turn shape, writing an adapter.
- [Measured](docs/measured.txt): the fixture table from `bun test/calibrate.ts --write`.
